standard_prerequisites.name: The cover number c(G) of a graph by comparability graphs
standard_prerequisites.statement: c(G) is the smallest number of comparability subgraphs of G needed to cover the edge set of G, without requiring them to be edge-disjoint; the article's own definition is retained at source line 129, together with p(G) at source line 128.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted theorem is a lower bound for exactly this parameter, so the object being bounded must be fixed before the statement can be read.

standard_prerequisites.name: The interval graph G_n and the numbers c(n) and p(n)
standard_prerequisites.statement: For n at least 2, G_n is the intersection graph of the n choose 2 closed intervals whose endpoints are among n consecutive positive integers, and the article abbreviates c(n)=c(G_n) and p(n)=p(G_n); retained at source lines 391-395.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lower bound is the statement c(n) >= log log(n) / 2 for these graphs, and the proof works with a cover of G_n by comparability subgraphs.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nested, crossing and touching pairs of intervals
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two distinct closed intersecting intervals with integer endpoints are nested when one contains the other; otherwise they are crossing when their intersection has more than one element and touching when the intersection is a single point; retained at source lines 397-400.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof labels the touching edges of G_n, so the notion of a touching pair and the shape of its endpoints i<j<k must be available.

standard_prerequisites.name: The double shift graph DS_n and its lower bound
standard_prerequisites.statement: The double shift graph has the triples (i,j,k) as vertices, with two triples joined when the last two entries of one are the first two entries of the other, and the article records at source lines 427-428 the corollary that its chromatic number is at least log log(n), obtained from a result of Erdos and Hajnal; the vertices and adjacency rule are retained at source lines 421 and 424-425.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof converts a cover of G_n by t comparability subgraphs into a proper colouring of DS_n by 2t colours, so both the graph and the quoted lower bound on its chromatic number must be available.

core_obligations: Assume that the edge set of G_n is covered by t comparability subgraphs H_1,...,H_t and fix a transitive orientation of each H_i (source lines 438-439).

Assign to every touching edge e = {[i,j],[j,k]} a type, that is a pair (m,+) or (m,-): the index m records that e lies in H_m and the sign records whether e is oriented from [i,j] to [j,k] or in the opposite direction; where several indices are possible choose one arbitrarily, and note that there are 2t types in all (source lines 440-445).

Show that two consecutive touching edges e = {[i,j],[j,k]} and f = {[j,k],[k,l]} with i<j<k<l must have different types: otherwise the transitivity of the orientation of that single subgraph produces an edge of G_n joining the disjoint intervals [i,j] and [k,l], which is impossible (source lines 447-449).

Read this as a proper colouring of the double shift graph DS_n by the 2t types: the triple (i,j,k) receives the type of the touching edge {[i,j],[j,k]}, and consecutive triples receive different colours (source lines 451-453).
Combine with the lower bound on the chromatic number of DS_n to obtain 2t >= log log(n) and hence c(n) >= t >= log log(n) / 2 (source line 453).

proof_roadmap.step: Assume that t comparability subgraphs cover the edge set of G_n and orient each of them transitively.
Type every touching edge by the index of a subgraph containing it and the direction of that orientation, giving 2t types.
Prove that two touching edges sharing a middle interval must have different types, by transitivity plus the disjointness of the outer intervals.
Turn the types into a proper colouring of the double shift graph and conclude 2t >= log log(n).

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2408.13523v2 的 Theorem loglog（源 432-433 行，证明 438-453 行，共 16 行）：对 n 个基点确定的区间图 G_n 证明 c(n) >= (1/2) log log n。关键操作不是例行核验：必须先把覆盖 G_n 的 t 个可比子图各自取传递定向，再把每条相切边编码成「所在子图的编号 + 定向方向」这一类型，从而得到 2t 个类型（440-445 行）；关键一步是证明共享同一个中间区间的两条相切边 {[i,j],[j,k]} 与 {[j,k],[k,l]} 类型必定不同，否则单一子图的传递性会给出连接两个互斥区间 [i,j] 与 [k,l] 的边，而这条边在 G_n 中并不存在（447-449 行）；最后把类型读成双移位图 DS_n 的一个 2t 色正常着色，再用 χ(DS_n) >= log log n 收尾（451-453 行）。难点在于把「边集被可比子图覆盖」这一结构性质精确转译成一个着色的存在性，且类型数必须恰好是 2t；原文位置在证明的 440-445 行与 447-449 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Theorem loglog at source lines 432-433 together with the author's proof that opens with the bold header Proof. at source line 438 and closes with the square at source line 453; the proof is preceded by a medskip, so the pairing is by adjacency through blank lines only.

The retained context at source lines 128-129, 391-395 and 397-400 is the article's own definitions of the parameters c(G) and p(G), of the interval graph G_n with the abbreviations c(n) and p(n), and of the nested, crossing and touching pairs of intervals.

The retained context at source lines 421, 424-425 and 427-428 is the article's own introduction of the double shift graph DS_n, its vertices and adjacency rule, and the corollary that its chromatic number is at least log log n; the intervening sentence of source line 426, which carries a bibliographic citation to Erdos and Hajnal, is not retained, so the material carries no bibliography.

The source preamble cannot be retained as it stands: it loads rawfonts, psfrag, verbatim, tikz with several libraries, hyperref with the pagebackref option and a dvi driver option for graphicx, none of which the retained body spans use, and it redefines backref commands that only exist because of that hyperref option. The retained preamble file therefore carries, line for line, source line 2, source line 3, source line 4, source line 16, source line 17, the theorem declarations of source lines 20-30 and the author macro definitions of source lines 32-41; the only textual change anywhere is the removal of the dvipdfm driver option from the graphicx line, because the assembly forces the xelatex engine. No new macro, package or declaration was introduced.

The article's theorems co-triangulated, unit, gensplit, bipline and ub, its lemma rec, its corollaries doblesh, shift and p', and its proposition H9 are not counted here; of these only the corollary on the chromatic number of DS_n is retained, and it is retained as context for the quoted lower bound rather than as a premise proved in this material.
